monsters.name: ABORTITO
monsters.pokedex_text: It can be carried away on even the gentlest breeze. It may even float all the way to the next town.

monsters.name: INCUBATO
monsters.pokedex_text: As soon as it rains, it closes its flower and hides in the shade of a tree to avoid getting wet.

monsters.name: ITTIOSO
monsters.pokedex_text: Even in the fierc- est wind, it can control its fluff to make its way to any place in the world it wants.

monsters.name: MOLESTO
monsters.pokedex_text: This little silly creature, sneaks into public places like video arcades to grope innocent underage girls.

monsters.name: GRUMO
monsters.pokedex_text: It is very weak. Its only means of defense is to shake its leaves desperately at its attacker.

monsters.name: OVARIAN
monsters.pokedex_text: As the hot season approaches, the petals on this POKéMON's face become more vivid and lively.

monsters.name: NAPALMYAN
monsters.pokedex_text: It can see in all directions without moving its big eyes, helping it spot attackers and food right away.

monsters.name: KOTZWAR
monsters.pokedex_text: A mucous membrane covers its body. Touching it barehanded will cause a shooting pain.

monsters.name: ASPHYXIAR
monsters.pokedex_text: Its body is always slimy. It often bangs its head on the river bottom as it swims but seems not to care.

monsters.name: EMBRYEON
monsters.pokedex_text: The tip of its forked tail quivers when it is predicting its opponent's next move.

monsters.name: DAMNATEON

evolves_from.name: DEADDOG
evolves_from.how: special: game counter at RAM $D9C6 is 5 or more

monsters.pokedex_text: On the night of a full moon, or when it gets excited, the ring patterns on its body glow yellow.

monsters.name: SKARKROW
monsters.pokedex_text: It hides any shiny object it finds in a secret location. MURKROW and MEOWTH loot one another's stashes.

monsters.name: DEPRECLOWN
monsters.pokedex_text: Every time it ya- wns, SHELLDER injects more poi- son into it. The poison makes it more intelligent.

monsters.name: HOSTED.GOO
monsters.pokedex_text: It loves to watch people it's scar- ed. It frightens them by screaming loudly or appear- ing suddenly.

monsters.name: CONDOMAX
monsters.pokedex_text: In order to con- ceal its black tail, it lives in a dark cave and only moves about at night.

monsters.name: ENIGMAGUS
monsters.pokedex_text: When it is in danger, its tail uses some sort of mysterious powers to drive away the enemy.

monsters.name: HIDENLAYER
monsters.pokedex_text: It spits out a fluid that it uses to glue tree bark to its body. The fluid hardens when it touches air.

monsters.name: /NEURONET
monsters.pokedex_text: Usually found hanging on to a fat tree trunk. It shoots out bits of its shell when it sees action.

monsters.name: DUOFUNTO
monsters.pokedex_text: It hides deep inside caves where no light ever reaches it and remains virtually motionless there.

monsters.name: TWOMEWTWO
monsters.pokedex_text: It builds its nest on a steep cliff. When it is done gliding, it hops along the ground back to its nest.

monsters.name: HYDRAGYRUM
monsters.pokedex_text: The many small metal particles that cover this POKéMON's body reflect bright light well.

monsters.name: BLEKHOLIA
monsters.pokedex_text: In truth, it is a cowardly POKéMON. It growls eagerly in order to hide its fear from its opponent.

monsters.name: GALAXIAN
monsters.pokedex_text: It can make most any POKéMON run away simply by opening its mouth wide to reveal its big fangs.

monsters.name: NAVALMINO
monsters.pokedex_text: When faced with a larger opponent, it swallows as much water as it can to match the opponent's size.

monsters.name: CYNOBI
monsters.pokedex_text: This POKéMON's pincers, which contain steel, can crush any hard object it gets a hold of into bits.

monsters.name: PROGLOTTO
monsters.pokedex_text: The fluid secreted by its toes carves holes in rocks for nesting and can be mixed with BERRIES to make a drink.

monsters.name: KINBUGUBI
monsters.pokedex_text: With its Herculean powers, it can easily throw arou- nd an object that is 100 times its own weight.

monsters.name: KUNOIGA
monsters.pokedex_text: This cunning POKéMON hides under the cover of darkness, waiting to attack its prey.

monsters.name: FLESHPLUSH
monsters.pokedex_text: It always licks honey. Its palm tastes sweet because of all the honey it has absorbed.

monsters.name: TAXYDERMA
monsters.pokedex_text: Although it has a large body, it is quite skilled at climbing trees. It eats and sleeps in the treetops.

monsters.name: MELTEFAS
monsters.pokedex_text: These group to- gether in areas that are hotter than normal. If it cools off, its skin hardens.

monsters.name: MAGCARGO
monsters.pokedex_text: Its body is as hot as lava and is always billowing. Flames will occasionally burst from its shell.

monsters.name: SWINUB
monsters.pokedex_text: It uses the tip of its nose to dig for food. Its nose is so tough that even frozen ground poses no problem.

monsters.name: PILOSWINE
monsters.pokedex_text: Although its legs are short, its rugged hooves prevent it from slipping, even on icy ground.

monsters.name: NEURAPSYS
monsters.pokedex_text: The points on its head absorb nutrients from clean water. They cannot survive in polluted water.

monsters.name: ANIFISH
monsters.pokedex_text: To escape from an attacker, it may shoot water out of its mouth, then use that force to swim backward.

monsters.name: TOSHIOKI
monsters.pokedex_text: Its instinct is to bury itself in holes. It often steals the nesting holes of others to sleep in them.

monsters.name: ANTENNOIDE
monsters.pokedex_text: It always carries its food with it, wherever it goes. If attacked, it throws its food at the opponent.

monsters.name: DADAORCA
monsters.pokedex_text: It swims along freely, eating things that swim into its mouth. Its whole body is very coarse.

monsters.name: AXIOM:APEX
monsters.pokedex_text: The feathers that it sheds are very sharp. It is said that people once used the feathers as swords.

monsters.name: HOUNDOUR
monsters.pokedex_text: Around dawn, its ominous howl echoes through the area to announce that this is its territory.

monsters.name: HOUNDOOM
monsters.pokedex_text: The pungent- smelling flame that shoots from its mouth results from toxins burn- ing in its body.

monsters.name: HERMAPHROD
monsters.pokedex_text: It stores energy by sleeping at underwater depths at which no other life forms can survive.

monsters.name: PHANPY
monsters.pokedex_text: During the desert- ed morning hours, it comes ashore where it deftly uses its trunk to take a shower.

monsters.name: DONPHAN
monsters.pokedex_text: Because this POKéMON's skin is so tough, a normal attack won't even leave a scratch on it.

monsters.name: BIBRODO
monsters.pokedex_text: This manmade POKéMON evolved from the latest technology. It may have unprog- rammed reactions.

monsters.name: SPIRITUS
monsters.pokedex_text: The round balls found on the fallen antlers can be ground into a powder that aids in sleeping.

monsters.name: SMEARGLE
monsters.pokedex_text: The color of the mysterious fluid secreted from its tail is predeter- mined for each SMEARGLE.

monsters.name: SKOONITSO
monsters.pokedex_text: To brush up on its fighting skills, it will challenge anyone. It has a very strong com- petitive spirit.

monsters.name: JUTSUFAITA
monsters.pokedex_text: After doing a handstand to throw off the opponent's timing, it presents its fancy kick moves.

monsters.name: LOLIPLEX
monsters.pokedex_text: The sensitivity of its lips develops most quickly. It uses them to try to identify unknown objects.

monsters.name: PHOTOKID
monsters.pokedex_text: It loves violent thunder. The space between its horns flickers bluish- white when it is charging energy.

monsters.name: CARBIFY
monsters.pokedex_text: It naturally spits an 1100-degree flame. It is said when many appear, it heralds a volcanic eruption.

monsters.name: INTENSIVO
monsters.pokedex_text: In order to milk a MILTANK, one must have a knack for rhythmically pull- ing up and down on its udders.

monsters.name: POSTPARTOU
monsters.pokedex_text: Having a child can bring serious mood disorders. That dead newborn in your hands will look like a dream.

monsters.name: ROTARAX
monsters.pokedex_text: This rough POKéMON stores energy inside its body, then sweeps across the land, shooting off electricity.

monsters.name: VITATEC
monsters.pokedex_text: This brawny POKéMON courses around the earth, spouting flames hotter than a volcano's magma.

monsters.name: SKYLITE
monsters.pokedex_text: This divine POKéMON blows around the world, always in search of a pure reservoir.

monsters.name: SEBUTAR
monsters.pokedex_text: Born deep under- ground, this POKéMON becomes a pupa after eating enough dirt to make a mountain.

monsters.name: MYCOTAR
monsters.pokedex_text: It will not stay still, even while it's a pupa. It already has arms and legs under its solid shell.

monsters.name: MELANOTAR
monsters.pokedex_text: In just one of its mighty hands, it has the power to make the ground shake and moun- tains crumble.

monsters.name: DEMEMENTIA
monsters.pokedex_text: It has an incred- ible ability to calm raging sto- rms. It is said that LUGIA appears when storms start.

monsters.name: PAGOLDIA
monsters.pokedex_text: It will reveal itself before a pure-hearted trainer by shining its bright rain- bow-colored wings.

monsters.name: CEREBRI
monsters.pokedex_text: Revered as a guardian of the forest, CELEBI appears wherever beautiful forests exist.

monsters.name: PARATYPE ABC
monsters.pokedex_text: Because different types of UNOWN exist, it is said that they must have a variety of abilities.
